name: Donanemab
route_note: Intravenous infusion every four weeks; treatment can stop once amyloid plaque is cleared on PET.
targets: Amyloid-beta (APP) N-terminal pyroglutamate (N3pG) form in plaques

discovery.note: A humanised IgG1 antibody designed to bind a truncated, pyroglutamate-modified amyloid-beta species found only in established plaques. Year is the priority date of the Lilly anti-N3pGlu amyloid-beta antibody patent (US 8,679,498).

rx_status: prescription (specialist; amyloid confirmation and MRI monitoring required)
tagline: Plaque-clearing Alzheimer's antibody with a limited-duration treatment course
summary: Donanemab is a humanised antibody that targets a modified form of amyloid-beta present in plaques, rapidly clearing amyloid from the brain. In TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2 it slowed clinical decline in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, and dosing can stop when plaques are cleared.
mechanism: Donanemab binds amyloid-beta beginning at pyroglutamate-3 (N3pG), a truncated species that is deposited in plaques rather than circulating in soluble form. Antibody-bound plaques are removed by microglia, producing large, fast reductions in amyloid PET signal.

As with other anti-amyloid antibodies, plaque removal can cause amyloid-related imaging abnormalities (ARIA), particularly in APOE ε4 carriers; a more gradual titration schedule approved in 2025 lowered ARIA-E rates.
uses: Mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia due to Alzheimer's disease with confirmed amyloid pathology

history.title: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ
history.detail: A phase 2 trial (Mintun et al., NEJM) reports amyloid clearance and slowing on a composite clinical score.

history.title: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2
history.detail: Phase 3 results (Sims et al., JAMA) show about 35% slowing on iADRS in participants with low-to-medium tau.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: After a unanimous advisory committee vote, the FDA approves Kisunla in July with a boxed warning for ARIA.

history.title: UK and Japan
history.detail: The MHRA (October) and Japanese regulators (September) approve donanemab; NICE draft guidance does not recommend NHS funding.

history.title: Modified titration
history.detail: The FDA approves a slower dose-titration schedule based on TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 6, reducing ARIA-E.

history.title: EU opinion
history.detail: After re-examination the CHMP recommends authorisation for APOE ε4 non-carriers and heterozygotes.

safety.boxed_warning: Amyloid-related imaging abnormalities (ARIA), which can be serious and life-threatening; higher risk in APOE ε4 homozygotes. Caution with antithrombotic and thrombolytic drugs.

facts: In TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2, participants could switch to placebo once amyloid fell below a set threshold, making donanemab the first anti-amyloid therapy with a finite course.

references.title: JAMA: Donanemab in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer Disease (2023)
